# 4->42, 5->2024; see run_pooled in the qsub script), so 8 seeds = 3x split 42, 2x split 2021, 3x split 2024.
# dual_heads rows need the 9/29 code change (--prediction_mode dual); smoke-test first (see sh_submit_9_29.sh).
